research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Juniper Networks is researching network optimization, security, and cloud-managed infrastructure. Work such as power optimization using dynamic bandwidth management between connected network devices and scalable multi-plane fabric-less connectivity for packet forwarding engine targets efficient, high-scale routing. Other efforts like intent-based enterprise security using dynamic learning of network segment prefixes and intelligent firewall policy processor focus on secure, policy-driven control. Additional innovations span SD-WAN, wireless access management, telemetry analytics, and optical interconnects.

about_short_description.short_description: Juniper Networks is a networking company that markets and develops networking products for enterprise companies.

product.name: Mist AI-Native Networking Platform
product.description: A cloud-based networking platform that uses AI and AIOps to monitor, analyze, and automate wired, wireless, WAN, and security operations.

product.name: Marvis AI
product.description: An AI network assistant that provides visibility, troubleshooting, and automated remediation across wired, wireless, WAN, cloud, and data center environments.

product.name: Wireless Access
product.description: Enterprise wireless access points and cloud services supporting Wi-Fi 7, Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth Low Energy, and location-aware deployments.

product.name: Wired Access
product.description: Enterprise Ethernet switches and cloud-managed assurance services for connecting users, devices, and applications across campus and branch networks.

product.name: SD-WAN and SASE
product.description: Software-defined WAN and secure edge networking solutions combining Session Smart Routers, next-generation firewalls, secure edge services, and cloud-based assurance.

product.name: Routing and Switching
product.description: Routers and switches for enterprise, service provider, cloud, metro, and data center networks, including ACX, MX, PTX, EX, and QFX series platforms.
